seen.where: Landesarchiv NRW Abt. Westfalen W 004 (Msc.VI) Nr. 119, images 1-134 downloaded 5 Nov 2026 from https://www.landesarchiv-nrw.de/data01/Abt_Westfalen/Msc_VI/00119/MSC_VI_00119_001.jpg ... _134.jpg (METS https://www.landesarchiv-nrw.de/digitalisate/Abt_Westfalen/Msc_VI/00119/mets.xml); Archivportal-D record https://www.archivportal-d.de/item/YJK5OEKXRL2FKG7HBBUATGIAMESBDZRX (behind an Anubis bot check, not read; its wording is taken from the lead).
seen.extent: Bound volume of 134 images, wrapper dated 1677 (Urkunden und Nachrichten zur Geschichte des vormaligen kurkoelnischen Herzogthums Westphalen, Erster Band); letters of Landsberg, Landstaende memorials and a March 1677-79 run of letters to 'Monsieur Schmidtman, Deputé du Duché de Westphalie à Wien' (images about 118-132); one key sheet on image 133.
seen.cipher: Image 133 is a loose sheet with an alphabet A-Z over numbers (A 10, B 12, C 16 ... Z 56) and a nomenclator of about 125 numbered words (armee, alliance, Bischof zu Muenster, Turenne, Brandenburg, Lothringen, munition, secours ...): the 'Dechiffrierschluessel' of the finding aid. The letters I viewed (about a dozen enlarged, the rest on contact sheets) are plain German with ordinary numerals ('2200 Rtl', '14 Bataillon'); I identified no line of cipher figures and no decipherment is written on the leaves, but a full leaf-by-leaf read of all 134 images was not possible.
